news.headline: Saints win at Baltimore 24-17
news.summary: New Orleans trailed 14-6 at halftime Sunday and scored 18 points after the break to beat the Ravens. Tyler Shough completed 27 of 34 passes for 252 yards, and Julian Blackmon intercepted Lamar Jackson in the last minute to end it.

news.headline: Cam Jordan plays his first game of the year
news.summary: The Saints said Saturday that defensive end Cam Jordan is cleared to play Sunday at Baltimore, his first game this season. Alvin Kamara is back too, and the defense has to handle Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry.

news.headline: Olave and Young are questionable for Sunday
news.summary: The Saints' final report Friday listed receiver Chris Olave with a hamstring problem and pass rusher Chase Young with a calf problem, so both are uncertain at Baltimore. Alvin Kamara and Cam Jordan have no injury tag and are set to play.

news.headline: Florida is ranked for the first time under Sumrall
news.summary: The Gators are No. 21 in the new Associated Press Top 25, which came out Sunday, after their 44-39 win at Auburn. It is the first time Florida has been ranked since Jon Sumrall became the coach.

news.headline: Florida beats Auburn 44-39 and is 3-0
news.summary: Jadan Baugh ran for 162 yards and three touchdowns Saturday night at Auburn, and Aaron Philo threw for 202 more. Auburn scored twice late, but Florida held on and is 3-0 for the first time since 2019.

news.headline: Florida will wait on Eric Singleton for Saturday
news.summary: Florida listed receiver Eric Singleton as questionable on Wednesday for the game at Auburn, the school he played for last season. He hurt his ankle on September 5 and will dress and try to play, and lineman Emmanuel Oyebadejo is questionable too.

news.headline: LSU drops to No. 10 after the loss
news.summary: LSU went from No. 7 to No. 10 in the new Associated Press Top 25 on Sunday after losing 32-24 at Ole Miss. The Tigers are 2-1 and host Texas A&M on Saturday night in Baton Rouge.

news.headline: Ole Miss holds off LSU 32-24
news.summary: LSU trailed 24-7 at halftime Saturday night in Oxford, came back to tie the game, then gave up a touchdown and a two-point play. A fourth-down pass was picked off in the end zone at the end, and LSU is 2-1.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt is off the injury report
news.summary: LSU took its quarterback off the conference injury report Friday night, so he is set to start Saturday night at Ole Miss. He was listed as doubtful on Wednesday and questionable on Thursday.

news.headline: Kansas State beats Tulane 31-20
news.summary: Tulane scored on its opening drive Saturday morning, but Kansas State quarterback Avery Johnson ran for 152 yards and two touchdowns and the Wildcats pulled away. Kicker Cooper Helmke made a 58-yard field goal, the longest in Tulane history, and the Green Wave are now 1-2.

news.headline: Dickson Agu honored after a 14-tackle game
news.summary: Agu made 14 tackles in Saturday's win over South Alabama, the most by a Tulane player in a game since 2023. On Tuesday he was named one of six national comeback players of the week, a year after a knee injury cost him most of last season.

news.headline: Two Tulane players hurt with Kansas State next
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that linebacker Chris Rodgers is getting a second opinion and that the team is still finding out how long tight end Ty Thompson will be out. Tulane plays Saturday morning at Kansas State, which is 2-0.

news.headline: Brother Martin rolls past Warren Easton
news.summary: The Crusaders beat Warren Easton 56-6 on Friday night for their third straight win to start the season. Brother Martin is 3-0 and hosts Jesuit next Friday.
